title: Painting a Farm Road
content: (Link to YouTube video) Starting with transparent watercolor and finishing with a few touches of opaque gouache, I paint a farm road. The gravel road is lined with bare trees, vines, and grassy fields.To tell the story of traveling back in space, I include my bike parked against a rustic fence and a family walking along the road.Art supplies listed in description belowYouTube video
